h1: Steel Storage Unit Buildings in Wyoming, Utah & Idaho
answer: Brooks Steel Buildings supplies custom pre-engineered steel buildings for mini storage, drive-up storage units, and RV and boat storage. Long clear-span buildings keep your layout flexible, and every building is engineered for your site’s snow and wind loads.
intro_p: Storage facilities need long, efficient buildings that are easy to repeat and easy to expand. Steel framing gives you clear spans, simple construction, and low maintenance. We design the width, length, and door openings around your unit mix, then engineer the building for your site. Explore dimensions, rooflines, colors, and openings in our 3D designer before you call.

faq: What size should storage unit buildings be?
It depends on your unit mix and your site. Tell us the unit sizes you plan to offer and the land you have, and we will help you choose a width, length, and eave height.
Can I build storage units myself?
Yes. Many owners build their own storage units or hire a local contractor. Your building package is prepared for accurate, efficient assembly.
No. We design the building and its openings for the roll-up doors you choose, and they are installed by others. We supply commercial walk doors (man doors).
Can storage buildings be climate controlled?
Yes. We supply insulation. Tell us how you plan to use the units and we will include the right options in your quote. Heating and cooling systems are by others.
Can I add more units later?
Yes. Steel buildings can often be designed so bays can be added later, or you can add more buildings on the site. Let us know your plans so the design allows for it.
Can you build RV and boat storage?
Yes. We can design taller, wider bays for RVs, boats, and trailers. Tell us the largest unit you need to store and we will plan the height and door openings around it.
Do I need a permit for a storage building?
Yes, in most places. Requirements vary by county or city. Check with your local building department. Your building is engineered for local codes, with plans prepared for permitting.
How long does it take to get a storage building?
Our current turnaround is 8 to 10 weeks. Timelines can vary with project size, options, and demand.
